title: Rematch round 2, Skippy Core's coder: lost to Haiku's round 2 train
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8) as a vanilla agent (Claude Code with purple's system prompt, an empty setup, effort high, a 131K window) plus purple's generic help: eyes (Core's vision model describes the pictures it opens) and the stop gate's work check (MineBench's runtime as the checker, the renderer as the viewer, an 80K output-token budget)
verdict: Lost to Haiku's head-to-head round 2 train (blind judge, high confidence). The work check earned its keep: it caught a build that failed MineBench's runtime and the coder fixed it before finishing, so this round's code runs (140 turns, 32 minutes; one look at its picture, no budget nudge needed). The judge: a small train on a huge 256 x 256 grass plate, a grey ribbed locomotive with a black stack and smoke, then brown and red-and-yellow cars, wheels showing from the back, a platform nearby; but the train is a sliver of the scene, the ground is riddled with big black holes and crescent cutouts, and the locomotive reads more like a boxy building than a steam engine. Haiku's: a black locomotive with a red cab, a tender and three coaches in a line on the track by a small station.
